blocks.text: Interior design project for a 43 m² duplex apartment

parts.html: A 43 m² two-level apartment. We handled the full cycle: an interior design project with 3D visualization, technical documentation, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. The project covers the living room, bedroom, a kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, the entrance hall and bathroom, and the furniture for each area was made to our drawings. Before the renovation began, the client received a detailed cost estimate for labor, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures and lighting.
The page starts with three visualizations, followed by photos of the finished apartment and a video, so you can compare the design with the result.

Downstairs, the kitchen, dining area and living room share one space with a high ceiling and large windows. Over part of the room is a mezzanine with a railing of wooden slats and glass. The stairs up run on a single metal stringer: the dark wood treads seem to hang in the air, and the handrail is a thin black strip on the wall. The wall along the stairs is finished in gray concrete-effect decorative plaster, with small black wall lights.

The space under the stairs is put to use. White gloss panels cover the whole wall, with a dark glass inset for the TV and a narrow black niche for candles. Below hangs a long unit with walnut-effect fronts. Next to it is a light armchair on a black metal frame.

The kitchen is an island by the window with a white countertop and a built-in cooktop. The island is clad in walnut veneer, with a built-in black glass oven below. On the window side the countertop doubles as a breakfast bar, with stools on black metal frames with wooden backs and turquoise cushions. Storage cabinets are hidden behind smooth white floor-to-ceiling fronts.

There are only a few materials, and they repeat throughout: glossy gray marble-effect tiles on the floor, white gloss, dark wood, black metal and gray plaster. The windows have white sheers and floor-length gray curtains. There is one color accent: turquoise textiles.
